provision.quote: Challenge is to show cause notice dated 25/06/2025 issued by respondent no. 1, under Section 73 of The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (for short “CGST Act”).

financial_years.quote: The notice dated 25/06/2025 pertains to financial years 2019-20 to 2021-22 saying that the petitioner has, during this period, suppressed taxable value, and thereby made short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax.

document_contents.quote: The notice dated 25/06/2025 pertains to financial years 2019-20 to 2021-22 saying that the petitioner has, during this period, suppressed taxable value, and thereby made short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax.

defects_argued.quote: The show cause notice dated 25/06/2025 issued by respondent no. 1 is quashed and set aside.

outcome.quote: With the above liberty, and for the reasons set out in Milroc Good Earth Developers (supra) and RiteWater Solutions (India) Ltd.(supra), the petition is partly allowed.

review.notes: Court followed Bombay rule against consolidated notices, acknowledged conflicting Delhi view and pending Supreme Court challenges; fresh-notice liberty is not remand.
